cards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original mystical emblem illustration for a Japanese numerology app. Square 1024x1024. Cohesive series matching antique celestial tarot art: deep midnight navy, exquisite fine antique gold engraving and ivory highlights, subtle blue nebula and stardust, thin elegant circular gold frame, carefully restrained luminosity. Refined timeless design, strongly legible on a phone. No watermark, no labels, no Hebrew lettering, no extra numbers. This is an original artistic numerology emblem, not a historical religious correspondence. TREE OF LIFE. No text or numerals whatsoever. Sphere diameters approximately 0.09 of image width. Do not add an eleventh central sphere. Fine connected paths and softly radiant nodes, stars clearly tiny and distinct from the ten spheres. Decorative outer circle subtle. Sculptural jewel-like gold spheres with restrained glows.
